frequency_question: What proportion of nominated major executive branch officials are successfully confirmed by the U.S. Senate?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations for cabinet and agency-head level positions sent to the Senate where the administration actively supports the nominee and the Senate is in session, excluding withdrawals driven entirely by sudden personal scandals completely unrelated to political or policy will.
window: Within any active congressional session up to a 63-day operational window
coverage_note: 10 prominent recent major executive nominations examined; all successfully confirmed when prioritized by the administration.
known_gaps: Excludes minor sub-cabinet positions which face lower prioritization.
validity_reason: Bound to the current institutional dynamics and rules of the U.S. Senate until the end of the current presidential term.
